# CHIP-8 Emulator

Build a complete, self-contained CHIP-8 emulator in a single HTML file.

## Requirements

- Single file: `chip8_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html`
- HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline
- No external libraries, CDNs, assets, or backend

## Interpreter

- 4 KB of memory, font set at `0x050`, programs loaded at `0x200`
- 16 8-bit registers `V0`–`VF`
- 16-bit index register `I`
- Program counter `PC`
- Call stack
- Delay and sound timers decrementing at 60 Hz

## Instruction set

Decode and execute the complete 35-instruction set:

- Arithmetic and logic group with carry/borrow flags in `VF`
- Shift instructions
- Jumps and calls
- Random instruction
- BCD conversion
- Register save and load
- Key tests (press and release)

## Display

- 64×32 pixel canvas, scaled to a readable size
- Sprites drawn by XOR
- Collision flag set in `VF`

## Keypad

- 16-key keypad mapped to a 4×4 block of keyboard keys
- Mapping shown in the interface
- Key press and release both reach the emulator

## Demo ROM

- Small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file
- A real program, hand-assembled, that draws a sprite and moves or reacts to a key
- Emulator usable without any download

## ROM loading

- Load a ROM from a local file

## Controls

- Run, pause, single step, reset
- Adjustable instructions-per-frame speed

## Debugger panel

- Registers, index register, program counter, stack, decoded current instruction

Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file.

## Instructions

The file must be self-contained. Build it now.
